## About

Hi, I'm Reza Sedaaghi (known as Parham), a Software Developer specializing in Python, Node.js, React, PostgreSQL, Docker, and CI/CD pipelines. From data processing and automation to scalable backends and modern frontends, I design and build efficient solutions that stand up to real-world traffic and complexity.
